text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before a massive stake driven into the wall stood Yaeno Muteki and the others.
It appeared they were practicing sumo, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Yaeno-san!
Get set... and wrestle, wrestle!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ooooooohhhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Mmmrrgh!! Haaah!!
Kh...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Get the hell outta here alreadyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!?
Th-The stake... got smashed to smithereens...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Kh, how pathetic of me!
To crush the stake right when I should have driven it in...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No matter what... as I unleash my palm strikes,
my heart is engulfed in raging flames...!
Urging me to strike down and annihilate the foe before my eyes...!

Well then~...
Do you mind if I give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You are... Akebono-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I know the trick to this.
Watch me for a sec~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Thanks for the feast!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Wh-What!? In a single blow... all the way to the core!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Sumo wrestlers can put on such amazing bouts...
because they have opponents they can clash against with all their might."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When doing sumo thrusts, you can't put feelings of wanting to beat down your opponent into them.
You have to put the desire for an incredible opponent to take your full strength!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it's the same even if your opponent is Mr. Wooden Stake! Palm thrusts are just another ingredient in the chanko pot! Right, Yaeno-san?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...As expected of Akebono-san. It seems I, Yaeno, had forgotten the fundamental virtue of respecting one's opponent."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Consider the post your friend...
and unleash your thrusts with all your heart!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The post is my friend... The post is my friend...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case, to make it easier to empathize,
I'll voice Mr. Stake!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Ossu! Please take care of me!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, let's set Sakura Wanko-O on the post...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm Sakura Bark-O-King, woof!
I'll take on Miss Yaeno's feelings in a snap, woof!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I can't put on a tough act!!!!
She's just too cute!!!!
